findings.detail: For a reviewed child path such as module/src/file.go, historical guide discovery searches for module/AGENTS.md in the superproject's baseline tree. That tree contains a gitlink and cannot supply the child's guide. The prompt then prohibits loading checkout instructions, so review can report success without applying mandatory child checks. The root-only lookup predates this change; the new recursive review exposes the mismatch. Resolve historical child guidance using the child's object database and the revision pinned by the trusted parent baseline, recursively.
findings.evidence: render_scope recursively visits initialized child scopes at codex-aspects:447-454. render_guides selects only the outer .base // .head at line 568 and passes that revision and outer top_level to historical_guide at line 580. historical_guide queries that repository with ls-tree at line 540 and treats an empty result as absence. No child repository/revision resolution occurs. The prompt requires the supplied historical guidelines and rejects current checkout instructions.
findings.title: Parallel paths: recursive review omits historical child guidance
